verses.text: They that trust in Jehovah Are as mount Zion, which cannot be moved, but abideth for ever.

segments.text: Are as mount Zion, which cannot be moved, but abideth for ever.

verses.text: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, So Jehovah is round about his people From this time forth and for evermore.

segments.text: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem,
So Jehovah is round about his people
From this time forth and for evermore.

verses.text: For the sceptre of wickedness shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; That the righteous put not forth their hands unto iniquity.

segments.text: For the sceptre of wickedness shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous;
That the righteous put not forth their hands unto iniquity.

verses.text: Do good, O Jehovah, unto those that are good, And to them that are upright in their hearts.

segments.text: Do good, O Jehovah, unto those that are good,
And to them that are upright in their hearts.

verses.text: But as for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, Jehovah will lead them forth with the workers of iniquity. Peace be upon Israel.

segments.text: But as for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways,
Jehovah will lead them forth with the workers of iniquity.
